**Identifying Color Placement**

I've made a breakthrough! I've been tracing the placement of color 2 (red) across various training examples. The key seems to be the center of the bounding box surrounding each shape. When the center of the shape's bounding box changes, it alters to color 2. The isolated pixel's color also seems irrelevant.
